name: bundled-provenance
argv:
import pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)))
import hashlib, importlib, importlib.metadata, json, pathlib, sys, sysconfig
required = ('server','source_subscriptions','index','uoink_mcp','source_manifest','podcasts','library_work')
modules = {}
errors = []
for name in required:
    try:
        mod = importlib.import_module(name)
        path = pathlib.Path(getattr(mod, '__file__', '') or '')
        resolved = str(path.resolve()) if path else None
        digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None
        modules[name] = {'ok': True, 'file': resolved, 'sha256': digest}
    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append({'module': name, 'type': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)})
        modules[name] = {'ok': False, 'error': type(exc).__name__}
mcp_version = None
try:
    import mcp
    mcp_version = importlib.metadata.version('mcp')
except Exception as exc:
    errors.append({'module': 'mcp', 'type': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)})
usersite = ''
try:
    usersite = sysconfig.get_path('purelib', scheme='nt_user') if sys.platform=='win32' else ''
except Exception:
    usersite = ''
report = {
    'schema': 'c22-provenance-v1',
    'executable': str(pathlib.Path(sys.executable).resolve()),
    'version': sys.version.split()[0],
    'nousersite': bool(sys.flags.no_user_site),
    'prefix': sys.prefix,
    'path': [str(p) for p in sys.path],
    'usersite_scheme': usersite,
    'usersite_on_path': bool(usersite and any(str(p).lower().startswith(str(usersite).lower()) for p in sys.path)),
    'modules': modules,
    'mcp_version': mcp_version,
    'import_errors': errors,
}
print(json.dumps(report))
raise SystemExit(0 if not errors else 2)
